title: Brex closing band
description: A half-dark, half-photo closing band about half the window tall: on desktop a near-black left half with a 48px white headline, a white sentence and a large orange button, and a full-bleed photo slot on the right. On phones the photo comes first as a band, with the dark text block below.
notes: media slot: a photo that fills the right half
the text half forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class
height follows the window (53svh minimum) on desktop
name: brex-cta

props.name: media
props.description: the photo. A placeholder when empty
